# Placeholder fixture of the 2026-09-23 `HenkSwapPressure` case

The same shape as the real reconstructed case on rp5, and none of its data. The
real material stays on rp5's audit volume and never enters the repository.

- `inputs/henk-events.jsonl`: the preserved-event stand-in, ntfy frames as the
  `henk-events` cache holds them (the firing frame, its resolve, one unrelated frame).
- `inputs/audit-records.jsonl`: the audit-record stand-in, v4 records with tool
  names only, as the real records keep them.
- `inputs/henk-handoffs.jsonl`: the original-handoff stand-in.
- `inputs/reference.json`: the paraphrased reference. The fullness branch fired; the
  culprit was a host unit's page-cache burst triggered by a package upgrade; not a
  leak; it recurs on upgrade.
- `capture/<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>/`: captured-response files for the three `T` values of
  the real capture, in exactly the shape `henk/replay/capture.py` writes, cut down to
  the vps swap story. The nine D3/D4/D5 roles say `source: "written-out"`, as the rp5
  capture does.

Placeholders only: `host-a.example`, `example-a.service`, RFC 5737 addresses.
`tests/test_replay_fixture_publication.py` runs the pre-commit checks over this
directory. The capture is generated by `tests/replay_case_fixture.py`; regenerate it
after a registry template change with `python -m tests.replay_case_fixture`.
